translation: (Polygonum-seed 蓼實 is its envoy; it is averse to salvia 丹參, saltpeter 硝石, and 白堊, and is in dread of purple quartz 紫石英.) Original text of the Benjing: Evodia (吳茱萸), flavor pungent, warm. It chiefly treats warming the center and down-driving qi, stopping pain, cough and counter-flow with chills and fever, dispelling damp blood-impediment, and driving out
